purpose: Authoritative player-facing Uma Musume terminology for common gameplay/UI labels and named mechanics. For listed concepts, preserve the accepted English/Romanized player term instead of mechanically translating it into Vietnamese.
reference_note: The common EN terminology set was updated from a Vietnamese community reference supplied by the project owner. Individual skill NAMES are handled separately by style_rules.json and should normally be localized into concise Vietnamese/Han-Viet game-style titles.
precedence: accepted form in this file for a matching player-facing concept
locked matching entry in glossary/term_registry.json for concepts not overridden here
official in-game English/Romanized term or strongly established player shorthand
generic Vietnamese translation only when the concept is genuinely generic
rules: Current Vietnamese output is not evidence that a game term is correct.
For a matching concept in this file, the accepted English/Romanized form overrides an older conflicting Vietnamese target in term_registry.json until that registry is migrated.
When require_accepted is true and a source alias matches, keep/revise decisions must preserve one accepted or compact form.
Forbidden forms are known misleading/noncanonical calques and must not survive keep/revise.
Common gameplay terms such as stats, race surfaces, distance classes, running styles, Skill labels, and established event mechanics stay in English/Romanized form.
Individual skill names are NOT covered by the keep-English rule: localize those names according to glossary/style_rules.json.
If an unfamiliar named mechanic is not covered here or by term_registry, verify it or defer instead of inventing a Vietnamese canonical term.
Generic ウマ娘/赛马娘 uses Mã Nương in Vietnamese prose/dialogue; preserve Umamusume: Pretty Derby when the full product title is present.
Named Conditions use their established English player-facing names; do not translate condition labels literally from zh-CN.
Skill Pt, Skill Hint, Spark/Sparks, and running-style names are canonical gameplay vocabulary and must not be Vietnamese calques.
